data.title: 雷电将军 · 离岛海滨的清凉微风
data.description: 离岛的午后海风掠过白沙，雷电影穿着深紫色泳装站在浅浅的浪线旁。她双手扶着遮阳伞柄，回过头确认你是否跟上，长长的紫色发辫被风带向一侧。伞影刚好遮住她的脸，露出带着一点拘谨的浅笑，身后的蓝海与云层在日光里显得格外明亮。
data.location: 离岛蔚蓝海岸的白沙滩
data.action: 赤足站在白沙浅浪旁，双手扶遮阳伞柄，回眸露出拘谨的浅笑。
data.camera: full body, eye level, seaside portrait
data.promptProse: Raiden Ei pauses barefoot where shallow foam crosses Ritou's white sand, steadying the parasol handle with both hands. Her purple swimsuit and wind-drawn braid remain fully visible at eye level as she looks back with a hesitant smile. The parasol shades her face while afternoon sun illuminates her shoulders and leaves its broad shadow behind her feet; bright clouds rise beyond the blue water.
